patchNotes.title: CeyBlox themes
patchNotes.text: CeyBlox Dark is the default built-in theme; CeyBlox Light is the second built-in theme.

patchNotes.title: Addon theme test
patchNotes.text: The dummy Neon theme is addon-owned and only appears when that addon theme feature is enabled.

patchNotes.title: Preset card size
patchNotes.text: Preset cards keep a fixed readable size and the library scrolls instead of shrinking them.

patchNotes.title: News date memory
patchNotes.text: Selected News Center date is shared across tabs until the popup closes.

patchNotes.title: Missing model test
patchNotes.text: Invalid test addon models show a compact placement warning rather than silently doing nothing.
